theorem QOU.Machinery.MarkovTowerBridge.gwg_trace_towerE_of_spanning {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {q : R} {Hn : Type u_2} [Ring Hn] [Algebra R Hn] {σn : ℕ → Hn} {Hlow : Type u_4} [Ring Hlow] [Algebra R Hlow] {rank : ℕ} [HeckeTower.HeckeBraidedPresentationOfRank q rank Hn σn] (ιlow : Hlow →ₐ[R] Hn) (εlow : Hn →ₗ[R] Hlow) (n : ℕ) (z hbar : R) (instCE : HeckeTower.HeckeConditionalExpectation R q rank Hlow Hn σn ιlow εlow) (instMk : HeckeTower.HeckeMarkovExpectation R q rank Hlow Hn σn ιlow εlow n z) (instSp : HeckeTower.HeckeCosetSpanning R q rank Hlow Hn σn ιlow n) (tr : Hn → R) (g : Hn) (htr_add : ∀ (p r : Hn), tr (p + r) = tr p + tr r) (htr_zero : tr 0 = 0) (x y : Hn) (hlow : ∀ (a : Hlow), tr (x * (g * ιlow a * g) * y) = tr (x * ιlow a * y) + z * hbar * tr (x * ιlow a * y)) (hmid : ∀ (b c : Hlow), tr (x * (g * (ιlow b * σn n * ιlow c) * g) * y) = tr (x * z • (ιlow b * ιlow c) * y) + z * hbar * tr (x * (ιlow b * σn n * ιlow c) * y)) (w : Hn) :
tr (x * g * w * g * y) = tr (x * towerE ιlow εlow w * y) + z * hbar * tr (x * w * y)

theorem QOU.Machinery.MarkovTowerBridge.towerE_eq_of_spanning {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {q : R} {Hn : Type u_2} [Ring Hn] [Algebra R Hn] {σn : ℕ → Hn} {Hlow : Type u_4} [Ring Hlow] [Algebra R Hlow] {rank : ℕ} [HeckeTower.HeckeBraidedPresentationOfRank q rank Hn σn] (ιlow : Hlow →ₐ[R] Hn) (εlow : Hn →ₗ[R] Hlow) (n : ℕ) (z : R) (instCE : HeckeTower.HeckeConditionalExpectation R q rank Hlow Hn σn ιlow εlow) (instMk : HeckeTower.HeckeMarkovExpectation R q rank Hlow Hn σn ιlow εlow n z) (a : Hlow) (s : Finset ℕ) (b c : ℕ → Hlow) :
ιlow (εlow (ιlow a + ∑ i ∈ s, ιlow (b i) * σn n * ιlow (c i))) = ιlow a + ∑ i ∈ s, z • (ιlow (b i) * ιlow (c i))

theorem QOU.Machinery.MarkovTowerBridge.gwg_trace_of_spanning {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {q : R} {Hn : Type u_2} [Ring Hn] [Algebra R Hn] {σn : ℕ → Hn} {Hlow : Type u_4} [Ring Hlow] [Algebra R Hlow] {rank : ℕ} [HeckeTower.HeckeBraidedPresentationOfRank q rank Hn σn] (ιlow : Hlow →ₐ[R] Hn) (n : ℕ) (inst : HeckeTower.HeckeCosetSpanning R q rank Hlow Hn σn ιlow n) (tr : Hn → R) (g : Hn) (z hbar : R) (htr_add : ∀ (p r : Hn), tr (p + r) = tr p + tr r) (htr_zero : tr 0 = 0) (x y : Hn) (hlow : ∀ (a : Hlow), tr (x * (g * ιlow a * g) * y) = tr (x * ιlow a * y) + z * hbar * tr (x * ιlow a * y)) (hmid : ∀ (b c : Hlow), tr (x * (g * (ιlow b * σn n * ιlow c) * g) * y) = tr (x * z • (ιlow b * ιlow c) * y) + z * hbar * tr (x * (ιlow b * σn n * ιlow c) * y)) (w : Hn) :
∃ (a : Hlow) (s : Finset ℕ) (b : ℕ → Hlow) (c : ℕ → Hlow), w = ιlow a + ∑ i ∈ s, ιlow (b i) * σn n * ιlow (c i) ∧ tr (x * g * w * g * y) = tr (x * (ιlow a + ∑ i ∈ s, z • (ιlow (b i) * ιlow (c i))) * y) + z * hbar * tr (x * w * y)

theorem QOU.Machinery.MarkovTowerBridge.cyclic_two_g_of_tower {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {q : R} {Hn : Type u_2} {Hn1 : Type u_3} [Ring Hn] [Ring Hn1] [Algebra R Hn] [Algebra R Hn1] {σn1 : ℕ → Hn1} {rankHi : ℕ} [HeckeTower.HeckeBraidedPresentationOfRank q rankHi Hn1 σn1] (ι : Hn →ₐ[R] Hn1) (ε : Hn1 →ₗ[R] Hn) (inst : HeckeTower.HeckeConditionalExpectation R q rankHi Hn Hn1 σn1 ι ε) (trn : Hn → R) (g : Hn1) (z hbar : R) (hIH : ∀ (x y : Hn1), memB ι x → memB ι y → towerTrace trn ε (x * y) = towerTrace trn ε (y * x)) (hgwg : ∀ (x w y : Hn1), memB ι x → memB ι w → memB ι y → towerTrace trn ε (x * g * w * g * y) = towerTrace trn ε (x * towerE ι ε w * y) + z * hbar * towerTrace trn ε (x * w * y)) (u v p r : Hn1) (hu : memB ι u) (hv : memB ι v) (hp : memB ι p) (hr : memB ι r) :
towerTrace trn ε (u * g * v * (p * g * r)) = towerTrace trn ε (p * g * r * (u * g * v))
